buildCommand: cd ../.. && CHATJS_DOCS_HISTORY=$(git log --format=%cI --name-only -- 'apps/docs/*.mdx' | git hash-object --stdin) bunx turbo run build --filter=@chatjs/docs
ignoreCommand: test -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" && bunx turbo@2.10.12 --skip-infer --cwd ../.. query affected --base="$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" --head=HEAD --tasks build --packages @chatjs/docs --exit-code || exit 1
